output.subject: Thank you for your kind words about our Kingsbury Mall branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to call us and share such kind words about the staff at our Kingsbury Mall branch. You told us that one of our tellers helped you with estate paperwork, and you asked that they be recognized for that help.

We understand that handling an estate often comes at a difficult time. If you have recently lost someone close to you, please accept our sincere condolences. It means a great deal to hear that our team helped make part of that process a little easier for you.

Our Branch & Contact Center team will review your feedback and your request for recognition, and we will be in touch within 10 business days.

Thank you again for telling us about your experience. Feedback like yours is truly appreciated, and it helps us understand what matters most to the people we serve.

Warm regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a compliment, not a complaint. Consider whether a follow-up reply is needed at all, and adjust the 10-business-day line to match.
The teller is named in the original note. The draft refers to them only as 'one of our tellers'. Decide whether to name them in the reply.
Confirm that the compliment has reached the Kingsbury Mall branch manager. Decide whether to tell the customer how the teller will be recognized.
The estate paperwork suggests a recent bereavement. Check the condolence wording and confirm it fits the customer's situation.
Check whether the customer has any open estate-related matters that need separate follow-up.
